independence.sourceTupleReadScope: Only matching wholeCurrentSourceRow and own wholeCurrentGoalPCaseUnion member; historical binding metadata within that member is not a judgment and was not used as science.

actualWholeCurrentOrientation.title: Warum Wirtschaftswissenschaften? - Relevanz und Orientierung
actualWholeCurrentOrientation.description: Der Big-Picture-Einstieg zeigt, welche Möglichkeiten Wirtschaftswissenschaften im Alltag, bei gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe sowie in Studium und Beruf eröffnet und welche positiven Perspektiven der folgende Stoff bietet. Die lernende Person wählt nur, was sie neugierig macht oder ob sie weiterlernen möchte; fachliches Detailwissen wird hier weder vorausgesetzt noch geprüft.
actualWholeCurrentOrientation.descriptionEn: The big-picture introduction shows opportunities that Wirtschaftswissenschaften opens up in everyday life, social participation, studies and careers, and positive perspectives on the following material. The learner chooses only what sparks their curiosity or whether they want to continue learning; subject-specific knowledge is neither assumed nor tested here.

prerequisiteCheck.finding: Motivational entry with no own prerequisites and explicit absence of subject-knowledge assumption/test. Its completion is motivational orientation, not evidence of consumer mastery; no recall quota or subject knowledge gate is introduced.

primarySourceCheck.finding: Whole household section explicitly supplies utility/homo explanations, restricted rationality through preferences and consumption/saving decisions. Competence text supplies model construction and reasoned conclusions from targeted changes. Current P finite-menu interpretation fits these bounds; demand-curve/elasticity sibling clause not imported.

wholePCheck.scopeFinding: Both mandatory clauses explain consumer choices using wholly supplied preferences/menus/assumptions, distinguish scarcity, considered sets and preference differences, and do not require general optimisation, psychological diagnoses, demand-curve elasticity or independent successor mastery.

ownAdversarialChecks.case: Learner knows no economics and is curious about everyday shopping or chooses to continue. Existing orientation shows useful possibilities and the positive learning perspective without an economics quiz. A coach requiring an explanation of utility or opportunity cost to complete orientation would contradict the actual prerequisite description and AGENTS orientation contract.
ownAdversarialChecks.finding: Current prerequisite permits this knowledge-free entry; it is not an unnecessary content gate.

ownAdversarialChecks.case: Fictional household needs service for three months. Option S costs EUR8 at each month start, option L EUR18 upfront for the full three months. Only EUR10 is available now; EUR8 income is explicitly available at each later month start; no credit. L is cheaper over the whole horizon (18 versus24) but cannot be paid now, so S can be a defensible feasible choice. If both are now affordable, future use probability or cancellation conditions are explicitly unknown, a cheapest-total-cost slogan still cannot identify one rational choice.
ownAdversarialChecks.finding: This changes the spending structure and information horizon, not merely the numerical values of a fixed-bundle exercise. The current competence explains the interaction without private data, autonomous budget planning, universal utility or new mandatory performance.

ownAdversarialChecks.case: Given menu repair EUR14, second-hand replacement EUR16, new replacement EUR25; current budget20 and complete ordinal ranking second-hand>new>repair (including remaining money). Considering all gives second-hand; considering only repair gives repair; another person with repair>second-hand>new can legitimately choose repair with full information. If the first person instead considers second-hand and repair, the same second-hand choice occurs despite incomplete attention. All preferences, costs and considered sets are expressly supplied.
ownAdversarialChecks.finding: Choice alone cannot diagnose attention limits. Holding budget and preferences constant isolates a supplied consideration mechanism, while a matched comparison may reveal no choice effect. No universal price law, bias diagnosis or forced moral preference follows.

pageAndVisualizationCheck.visualMechanism: Visible wallet/coins, practical backpack contents and peers illustrate budget, use need and social context. Two bags invite comparison; the image asserts no numerical demand conclusion and proves no learner performance.
